protocol.partition: frozen OMPAL Train rows only; Dev/Test never used
protocol.label: expected tone only where independently human-labelled tone_correctness=1
protocol.identity_usage: speaker_id is used only for GroupKFold; utterance_id is used only to aggregate label-blind pitch register within the current recording, then discarded before estimator input
protocol.model: fold-local median imputation + standardisation + deterministic LinearSVC(tol=0.01)
protocol.score_type: uncalibrated one-vs-rest decision margins; not probabilities
protocol.scope: research candidate only; not a sealed result or production model
